mentions.text:
According to Chinese media reports, several major smartphone makers have set lower shipment targets for 2027.

- Xiaomi is targeting about 90 million units in 2027, down 25% from its 2026 target of about 120 million.
- Lenovo (primarily Motorola) is targeting about 40 million units in 2027, down 20% from about 50 million in 2026.
- Apple is targeting about 220 million units in 2027, down 5.6% from about 233 million in 2026.
- Samsung is targeting about 210 million units in 2027, down 9.5% from about 232 million in 2026.
- OPPO is targeting about 90 million units in 2027, down 14% from about 105 million in 2026.
- vivo is targeting about 60 million units in 2027, down 29% from about 85 million in 2026.
- Huawei lowered its 2027 target to fewer than 50 million units, a decline of at least 16% from its 2026 target of about 60 million.
